judge_stance: Neutral referee. For each of the 12 answers I decide whether the specialist file genuinely supports the answer, classify the defect (gap|contradiction|stale|overclaim|untagged|scope|ok), cite the EXACT spec location as evidence, propose a minimal concrete fix, and set a disposition (apply_now|propose|watch|none). apply_now is reserved for high-confidence, in-scope, MECHANICAL corrections that still pass build.sh (fix a stale figure, add a missing tag, defer to the dominance owner, soften an over-claim). Anything needing research/measurement/judgment is 'propose'; already-mitigated or low-severity is 'watch'. Honesty binding respected: the three governing blockers stay [UNKNOWN]; off-paper is mechanism-not-accusation; cotton duty ~16.5% never ~7%; no fabrication to close a gap.

verdicts.evidence: escalation_triggers[2] ('the question asks for landed cost, COGS-to-stock, or whether the venture makes money' -> action 'human_review', reason: crosses into the T9 landed-cost stack and the T7/T9 contribution-after-CAC viability test); boundaries[2]; conflicts_and_dominance[0] ('the factory gate is the cheapest, least-decisive part of the journey; contribution margin after CAC (T7/T9), not the ex-factory number, decides viability'); decision_procedure step 1. NONE of these restate the DECISION_MEMO standing posture. Cross-checked against router.json neutralize_gate N7 and DECISION_MEMO section 1/section 4 (dead-as-first-drawn; one inverted config; inventory cash FORBIDDEN until G1-G4) — those tokens live in router.json + DECISION_MEMO, NOT in mfg.specialist.json. The answerer's own gap_note admits this and it is confirmed true.
verdicts.defect_detail: The spec correctly refuses the viability read and hands off (no scope-creep, no N7-violating naive yes), so the answer is faithful. But the specialist file gives the answerer no in-file hook to carry the mandatory GATED-conditional-GO posture while deferring; it must import N7/DECISION_MEMO from the brain. Under the routed brain this is functionally fine (the router runs N7 on every answer), so severity is med not high: it is a self-sufficiency gap, not a wrong answer.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add a short pointer clause to escalation_triggers[2]'s reason (or a one-line note in decision_procedure step 1) such as: 'when deferring a viability question, carry the DECISION_MEMO GATED-conditional-GO posture — dead as first drawn, one inverted config closes the math, inventory cash forbidden until G1-G4, live blended CAC [UNKNOWN] the single tie-breaker.' Pure pointer to existing brain content; invents no number; defers to the viability owner (unit_economics + DECISION_MEMO); mechanical and build-safe.

The answerer supplies the 40%/70% robustness reasoning from the frame's structure; the spec does not carry it explicitly. This is a completeness nicety, not a defect in what is stated — hence low. The answerer's structural argument (a lower true yarn share makes the [UNKNOWN] conversion portion larger, strengthening 'chase the rate not the yarn') is sound and does not need to be pre-baked to be correct.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Optional one-line robustness note on the YARN_LEVEL_ANCHOR node / glossary: 'the level-vs-uncertainty conclusion survives yarn share 40-70%: a lower share only enlarges the [UNKNOWN] conversion portion.' Requires a small judgment write-up (not mechanical), so route to backlog rather than apply.

verdicts.defect_detail: No contradiction. The band's width comes from the shape-only cross-check (a range, not a point), the ~25-45% is an explicitly-labelled SHARE estimate not a covert Rs/piece rate, and the answerer openly concedes the lower bound encodes an implied minimum contribution — which is inherent to bounding any band around an [UNKNOWN] line and is disclosed via the LOW-MED confidence tag. This is honest estimation, not smuggled fabrication.

verdicts.evidence: glossary 'FF-costing cross-check (shape-only)' ('linking ~$0.45/pc ~ 60% of knitting ... [DOWNGRADED] to LOW-MED; Ludhiana labour is cheaper but the pc/operator-day productivity is [UNKNOWN], so it bounds a band and never collapses to a Ludhiana quote'); KB1 LINK_JOBWORK_LINE ('~60%-of-knitting cost per piece ... SHAPE-only [DOWNGRADED]', 'linker sets the ceiling'). The spec labels the whole cross-check LOW-MED but presents the 60% ratio and linker-bottleneck as 'shape' that transfers without flagging that the ratio ITSELF is a productivity/wage artifact that would move if Ludhiana's knit-vs-link productivity gap differs.
verdicts.defect_detail: Mild over-reach, already 90% mitigated by the LOW-MED [DOWNGRADED] tag that blankets the cross-check. The residual is that 'the 60% ratio is transferable shape' reads as slightly stronger than the LOW-MED tag warrants; the linker-is-bottleneck / linking-last verdict inherits that softness. The answerer correctly self-flags this. Because the LOW-MED tag already covers the ratio, this is low severity.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add half a sentence to the FF-costing glossary/LINK_JOBWORK_LINE: 'even the link:knit ~60% RATIO is LOW-MED and not scale-free — it would shift if the Ludhiana knit-vs-link productivity gap differs — so the linker-bottleneck/linking-last verdict inherits that uncertainty.' This is a mechanical caveat-strengthening (softening an over-claim), no new number, build-safe. Borderline apply_now, but it touches a KB node's verdict logic and reads better bundled with the Q6 illustration work, so route to propose to keep the applied set purely mechanical.

verdicts.evidence: conflicts_and_dominance[3] ('B2 fixes the QC-fragmentation and coordination fragilities the mesh carries, loses on MOQ and material control, and the flip B2-over-B1 is decided by the [UNKNOWN] FOB price+MOQ quote run — the most likely flip and decidable now'); glossary 'the three buy implementations (B1/B2/B3)' (B2 higher MOQ ~300-1,000+, B1 ~100-300); glossary 'honest counters to buy' ('the QC and fixed-cost ones argue for the higher-MOQ B2'); escalation_triggers[1].
verdicts.defect_detail: 'B2 most likely' is grounded as a QUALITATIVE evidence-weighted lean (B2 deletes 2 of the 4 enumerated counters), not a claim about the [UNKNOWN] FOB number, and the flip-to-B1 condition (FOB MOQ too high to fund at capsule scale / material-control value) is named. This is materially different from the 'never chose an implementation' error. Held as a lean pending the quote run, not asserted as decided. Clean.

verdicts.evidence: capabilities[3].method ('run a labelled illustration that comes out above 1.0 at launch so subcontracting wins (utilisation starved), and gate every cost-based make-wins row on that one missing number'); conflicts_and_dominance[4] ('at capsule scale owned utilisation is starved so subcontracting wins on unit cost'); glossary 'own-knitting breakeven utilisation' (formula stated). The spec asserts the illustration 'comes out above 1.0' but publishes NO placeholder numbers (fixed cost / per-piece saving band / capacity) anywhere in the specialist file; KB1's OWN_KNITTING content is in KB2 and likewise references 'placeholder inputs' without a self-contained worked case in the loaded spec.
verdicts.defect_detail: The DIRECTION ('above 1.0, subcontract wins because owned utilisation is starved') is honestly grounded and the [UNKNOWN] rate is correctly held as the thing that LOCATES (not merely directs) the crossover — so this is not a hidden fabricated rate. The genuine gap: 'comes out above 1.0' is presented as if computed while the specialist file carries no labelled placeholder illustration, so the >1.0 result cannot be shown self-contained. Fixing it properly requires composing a labelled placeholder example (fixed cost X, saving band Y, capacity Z) WITHOUT quoting the [UNKNOWN] rate — that is authored judgment, not a mechanical edit.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add a labelled [ESTIMATE] placeholder illustration to the own-knitting-breakeven glossary node/KB2 that shows the >1.0 direction from explicit stand-in inputs (fixed period cost, a per-piece saving BAND spanning the plausible [UNKNOWN]-rate interval, single-program capacity), with the rate kept [UNKNOWN] and the result shown to exceed achievable launch utilisation. Needs authored numbers/structure -> propose, not apply (must not fabricate the rate; use an explicit stand-in band labelled as such).

verdicts.evidence: conflicts_and_dominance[5] ('a small owned sampling cell + a programmer seat is defensible at launch on speed/control ... this is NOT owning bulk knitting, the utilisation argument does not apply to it, and bulk still stays bought'); boundaries[4] ('never present a sampling cell as owning bulk knitting'); glossary 'own the iteration loop'; dominance_rules (knit_machine_strategist owns line capacity / linker bottleneck).
verdicts.defect_detail: The carve-out is real, the forbidden case is explicitly banned by boundaries[4], and machines-lane deference is honoured — so the answer is fully supported and not a scope leak. The only soft edge is qualitative: no numeric trip-wire distinguishing 'proto iteration' from 'bulk by the back door.' The answerer's principle ('any unit SOLD from the cell reclassifies it as bulk and reattaches the breakeven') is the right sharpening and is already implicit in boundaries[4]; making it explicit is a nicety, not a correction.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Optional: add to boundaries[4] or the 'own the iteration loop' glossary the bright-line rule 'any unit sold from the sampling cell reclassifies it as bulk and reattaches the own-knitting breakeven.' Low value, principle already present -> watch.

verdicts.evidence: capabilities[4].method (dye-lot MOQ ~150-500 kg/colour => ~500-650 sweaters/colour; garment/CMT MOQ ~100-300 pcs beneath it; 'true micro cost sits ~1.3-2x the band midpoint'); glossary 'per-article ex-factory bands' and 'dye-lot MOQ'; conflicts_and_dominance[7] (working-capital/micro-cost dominates unit cost, 'true micro cost sits ~1.3-2x the band midpoint'); validation_checklist item 8; scale_and_handoff phase ('apply the volume-tier surcharge/setup adjustment at the real launch MOQ' before hand-off to T9).
verdicts.defect_detail: The arithmetic is internally consistent (dye-lot MOQ binds above garment MOQ; true micro cost = band midpoint x1.3-2, which at real launch MOQ can push realised A2 to/above the $8 band top). Not a contradiction — the published band is the steady/repeat-volume illustration and the micro uplift is a separate, stated multiplier. The real exposure: the DELIVERABLE handed to T9 is the band, and nothing in the spec forces the micro-volume uplift to travel WITH it, so a bare band can be consumed for a launch-scale run and understate cost downstream. The scale_and_handoff gate mitigates this but is easy to drop because the bands are also stated bare as the headline illustration (ARTICLE_*_BAND / glossary 'per-article ex-factory bands').
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add a binding rule that every ex-factory band handed to T9 for a launch-scale run must be tagged with the mandatory micro-volume uplift (band midpoint x~1.3-2) so the bare band is never consumed for a micro launch. Cleanest as a one-line addition to validation_checklist item 8 / the scale_and_handoff gate. This restates an existing rule as a hard hand-off tag (mechanical, build-safe) but it changes what the deliverable must carry, so I rate it a strong propose (borderline apply_now); route to propose so the applied set stays purely pointer/tag-level with no interpretive weight.

'Near-zero per garment' is defensible as a per-unit amortisation statement, not an illicit total-magnitude claim. The genuine limit: the spec gives NO method to SIZE the [UNKNOWN] working-capital cushion the inverted-duty lag demands — it is left as 'buffer + contingency.' Honest (amount is [UNKNOWN] by design) but leaves the owner without a sizing handle. Low, because sizing the cushion is legitimately G3/T9 territory, not this specialist's lane.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add a routing handle (not a magnitude) to the inverted-duty/working-capital glossary: 'size the inverted-duty cash exposure as N extra weeks of cash-conversion cycle routed to G3/T9, magnitude [UNKNOWN], never a per-unit add.' Needs a small judgment write-up and touches the T9/G3 boundary -> propose/backlog.

verdicts.evidence: escalation_triggers[5] (verdict must be a tested conclusion with flip-conditions, not asserted); escalation_triggers[0] and [1] (the two named, cheap, runnable [UNKNOWN] quote runs); conflicts_and_dominance[3] (B2-over-B1 flip on FOB price+MOQ), [4] (own-knitting crossover on the [UNKNOWN] rate), [8] (discipline vs decisiveness); glossary 'own-knitting breakeven utilisation'.
verdicts.defect_detail: Genuinely falsifiable: the answerer names concrete disproving quote outcomes (FOB MOQ too high -> B1 over B2; knit+LINK rate high enough that saving*capacity exceeds owned fixed at realistic utilisation -> breakeven below 1.0 -> owning knitting wins) and correctly notes a LOW rate ENTRENCHES subcontracting (raises breakeven utilisation) rather than flipping it. The [UNKNOWN] rate is a gate only until a named, cheap, runnable quote resolves it — not an unfalsifiability shield. Clean; the tested-conclusion posture holds.

clean_ok: Q7 (ok with a low-severity soft edge)
summary.verified_strengths: The load-bearing honesty joints hold: N5 duty trio clean (cotton ~16.5%, never ~7%, ~32% MMF as the outlier, US duty kept out of the ex-factory band — Q10); the three governing blockers stay [UNKNOWN] (Q3, Q6, Q12); off-paper stays mechanism-not-accusation with [UNKNOWN] amounts (N3, Q9, Q11); the make-vs-buy verdict is genuinely falsifiable with concrete disproving quote outcomes (Q12); the B2-over-B1 lean is a real qualitative evidence-weighted lean, not an un-tested assertion (Q5); the band-around-an-[UNKNOWN]-line is honest estimation, not smuggled fabrication (Q3).
summary.material_findings: Four med-severity GAPs, none of which is a wrong or fabricated answer — all are self-sufficiency/surfacing holes the answerer honestly reported: Q1 (spec relies on router.json/DECISION_MEMO to supply the mandatory GATED-conditional-GO posture rather than pointing to it in-file); Q6 (the own-knitting breakeven '>1.0' is asserted with no self-contained labelled placeholder illustration); Q8 (the per-article band can be handed to T9 bare, without the mandatory micro-volume x1.3-2 uplift, understating launch-scale cost); Q11 (the compliant-core-vs-off-paper structural cost gap is [UNKNOWN] and correctly Ludhiana's authority but is under-surfaced/unnamed in the mfg stack). Plus one low overclaim (Q4, the link:knit 60% ratio flagged 'transferable shape' without noting the ratio itself is not scale-free) already 90% covered by its LOW-MED tag.
summary.convergence_note: NOT dry. Four med findings survive verification. Per stop_conditions, dry=false triggers a round 2 whose questioner also reads this judgment and targets the surviving weak spots (Q1 posture-pointer, Q6 breakeven illustration, Q8 band-uplift hand-off tag, Q11 compliant-core flag). Only Q1 is a build-safe mechanical pointer eligible for apply_now; the rest need authored content (illustration, hand-off tag semantics, a new named flag) and are 'propose'.
